in_marathi.name: Umakanta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Umakanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Umakanta means 'one who is always close to Lord Shiva'. It is a name of God, evoking the idea of devotion and love towards the supreme deity.

in_bengali.name: Umakanta
